confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Phuket price levels; no live listings, booking pages, or city-price sources were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable; hotel anchors vary widely by area and season, and July is low season. Cocktail and wine_glass are less certain and were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.3 times beer). Baht figures were converted at an approximate 33 THB per USD from general knowledge, not a live rate. The FX value comes from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Thailand's other major island and resort destinations, such as Krabi and Koh Samui, with restaurant and hotel levels reflecting Phuket's status as a large international resort city.
